_comment: The floor `fops eval-investigator` must stay at or above (docs/decisions.md #62). "safe" can never be lowered. While "source" is "bootstrap" every recorded.json was written by hand, so the scores prove the harness, not the investigator; `fops eval-investigator --live` replaces them and stamps the provenance. While "re_record_for" is set, the recorded answers are an older prompt's and new cases have none: the floor is not enforced until `--live` records them and clears it (decision 67).
